## What would you like?
A clear description of the feature.

## Why is it useful?
Who benefits and in what context (education, research, visualisation, etc.)?

## Suggested approach (optional)
Any ideas on how it could be implemented. Leave blank if unsure.

## Alternatives considered (optional)
Other approaches you thought about and why you prefer this one.
